rv.q: New York City Center's presentation of Hugo Marchand Artists at the Center is spectacular from the first minute to the last.
Arts Intel Report Stage Artists at the Center: Paris Opera Ballet Étoile Hugo Marchand Hugo Marchand in Maurice Béjart’s Bolero. When July 23–26, 2026.

cn.t: Critics hail Hugo Marchand's curated program as marvelous and potentially exceptional, with its thrilling range of works—from neoclassical to contemporary pas de deux—delighting dance enthusiasts at City Center.
